Real W key event drives player movement

results.check: Unobstructed weakpoint hits deal critical damage
results.method: Place player and sentinel in unobstructed rear lane, aim at optic and shoot

results.check: Enemy AI charges and fires damaging projectiles
results.method: Keep player stationary in an unobstructed lane against one sentinel for eight simulated seconds

results.check: All three objectives and extraction are traversable with normal movement and collision
results.method: Find cardinal routes on a one-metre collision grid; follow them using W movement and the normal fixed-step update, without teleporting. Claim each core through the normal interact method and return to insertion. Enemies are cleared between objectives to isolate traversal from combat.

results.check: Uncaught browser JavaScript exceptions during targeted suite

issuesFoundAndFixed: Deployment button focus could suppress keyboard control; deployment and resume now focus the canvas, and in-game button focus does not suppress movement.
Blender rifle initially obscured too much of the frame; reduced authored viewmodel to half scale, moved its receiver forward, and aligned optic height for ADS.
Initial Blender sentinel scale and critical hit sphere did not match the hovering model; normalized its dimensions and matched the optic hit volume.
Enemy clone cleanup attempted to dispose shared Blender geometry; shared geometry is retained while per-enemy materials are disposed.
Fast restart during Soul Shift could retain brief invulnerability; deployment now resets it to zero.
limitations: Traversal suite uses simulation stepping and removes enemies to isolate reachability; it is not an end-to-end unassisted human combat completion.
Debug hooks exist only when explicitly loading with ?test=1.
These checks establish functional behavior, not subjective perfection, AAA production quality, cross-device performance, or human playtest approval.
Root integration suite separately covers UI, full mission state transitions, reload, dash, settings, production build, and screenshots.
